title: Shared project agreement
objective: Agree on a supported exchange of project responsibilities.
walkAway: Continue with separate projects if no acceptable exchange is agreed.

sources.title: Illustrative shared project brief
sources.text: Team A can provide a workshop. Team B can provide a review session. Either team may continue with a separate project. Scope and dates require agreement by both teams.

strategies.fallback: Clarify scope and dates before committing; keep separate projects as the outside option.
